defect: Proof 4.1 identified every rank-zero normalized Thom class with 1 and every oriented cup-product map with the identity, which is false for a nonunit supplied orientation such as the reversed integral generator -1.
correction_basis: May's Thom theorem makes cup product with the chosen generator the isomorphism. In rank zero the chosen orientation is a unit-valued class o in H^0(B;R), so the map is multiplication by o with inverse multiplication by o^{-1}; it is the identity only for the standard unit orientation and multiplication by -1 for the reversed integral orientation.
